name: @bifold/dtg-vocab
description: Predicate Handling (cred-spec C4) and a mirrored copy of the dtgwg-vsc-registry's predicate vocabulary — the accept-list a verifier configures itself with, never dereferenced at verification time. See README.md for the mirror's deletion trigger.

scripts.build: echo 'building dtg-vocab 🏗️' && yarn run clean && yarn run build:vocab && yarn run compile && echo 'dtg-vocab built ✅'
